intent: Find which reference sequences contain the query region (E-value below 1e-10) and write the complete matching reference sequences to a FASTA file, pulling them out of references.fa by the subject IDs BLAST reports.
silent_error: makeblastdb -parse_seqids makes BLAST interpret IDs that look like database accessions: NC_000913.3 is reported as ref|NC_000913.3|, CP032666.1 as gb|CP032666.1|, AB123456.1 as dbj|AB123456.1| whenever sseqid is requested explicitly in -outfmt, while local-style names stay unchanged. The reported IDs then no longer equal the FASTA IDs, so 'seqkit grep -f' silently finds only the 4 local contigs and omits all 4 accession-named references. Every command exits 0; seqkit only logs '10 patterns loaded', and BLAST finds all 8 hits.
